title: Visualize Enqueue in a Circular Queue

blocks.content: Visualize Enqueue in a Circular Queue
Click the "Visualize this code" button below to see the new enqueue() in action.

1def enqueue(self, item):
2    if self.is_full():
3        print("We can't add elements. The queue is full.")
4        return
5    
6    self.rear = (self.rear + 1) % self.capacity
7    self.queue[self.rear] = item
8    self.count += 1
Next, we'll make a similar change in the dequeue() method to work with the circular queue.
